name: BulkPublish
author: BulkPublish
description: Post to your social channels from the bar: write, attach images, videos or documents, pick channels, then post now, add it to your queue, schedule it for a time, or save a draft. Retry anything that failed.

barWidget.description: Write a post, attach media, pick channels, and post now, queue it, schedule it or save a draft. Shows your recent posts and lets you retry failed ones.

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the bar checks your recent posts, so a failed one lights the icon. Opening the panel always refreshes.
